candidate.excerpt_original: The April 2021 AI baseline inventory contained 685 project and line item accounts that include AI-related activities.
candidate.excerpt_zh: 2021年4月的AI基线清单包含685个包含AI相关活动的项目和预算科目。

candidate.excerpt_original: JAIC officials said the April 2021 AI baseline inventory does not include operations and maintenance-related AI activities—such the JAIC’s overall operating budget—or any classified AI activities.
candidate.excerpt_zh: JAIC官员表示，2021年4月的AI基线清单不包括与运维相关的AI活动（如JAIC的整体运营预算）或任何机密AI活动。

candidate.excerpt_original: The JAIC’s April 2021 report to Congress stated that the JAIC plans to update and refine the AI Inventory Portfolio Analytics Tool using Agile methods over the next 2 to 3 years.
candidate.excerpt_zh: JAIC 2021年4月向国会提交的报告称，JAIC计划在未来2至3年内使用敏捷方法更新和完善AI库存组合分析工具。

candidate.excerpt_original: DOD officials reported collaborating on AI activities using informal and formal collaboration mechanisms, and that DOD intends to use the Joint Common Foundation as a mechanism to improve collaboration.
candidate.excerpt_zh: DOD官员报告称，他们使用非正式和正式的协作机制在AI活动上进行合作，并且DOD打算使用联合通用基金会作为改进协作的机制。

candidate.excerpt_original: In 2019, the JAIC began developing the Joint Common Foundation to create a department-wide data-sharing platform in lieu of each organization maintaining their data in separate systems as shown in figure 8.
candidate.excerpt_zh: 2019年，JAIC开始开发联合通用基金会，以创建一个部门范围内的数据共享平台，取代各组织在独立系统中维护其数据的做法，如图8所示。
candidate.normalized_claim: JAIC于2019年开始开发联合通用基金会，旨在建立部门级数据共享平台。

candidate.excerpt_original: As a part of this new initiative, the JAIC will send out “flyaway” teams of data and AI experts to help combatant commands quickly shift AI from labs to real-world warfighting.
candidate.excerpt_zh: 作为这项新计划的一部分，JAIC将派出数据和AI专家组成的“飞行”团队，帮助作战司令部快速将AI从实验室转移到实战。
candidate.normalized_claim: 作为AI与数据加速计划的一部分，JAIC将派出数据和AI专家团队，帮助作战司令部快速将AI从实验室转移到实战。

candidate.excerpt_original: According to a JAIC official and DOD documentation, budgetary and contracting issues (e.g., the cancellation of the Joint Enterprise Defense Infrastructure cloud contract), as well as the impacts of COVID-19, have delayed the Joint Common Foundation reaching full operational capability and an estimated date for that milestone has not been determined.
candidate.excerpt_zh: 据JAIC官员和国防部文件称，预算和合同问题（例如联合企业防御基础设施云合同的取消）以及COVID-19的影响，推迟了联合通用基金会达到全面作战能力，且该里程碑的预计日期尚未确定。
candidate.normalized_claim: 预算和合同问题及COVID-19影响推迟了联合通用基金会达到全面作战能力，且预计日期尚未确定。

candidate.excerpt_original: According to DOD officials, DOD planned to finalize a roadmap or high-level plan with milestones for the Joint Common Foundation by August 2021, but has experienced multiple delays, and as of November 2021 the roadmap was not finalized.
candidate.excerpt_zh: 据国防部官员称，国防部计划在2021年8月前最终确定联合通用基金会的路线图或包含里程碑的高层计划，但经历了多次延迟，截至2021年11月该路线图尚未最终确定。
candidate.normalized_claim: 国防部计划在2021年8月前最终确定联合通用基金会的路线图，但截至2021年11月该路线图尚未最终确定。

candidate.excerpt_original: According to the Director of the JAIC, the JAIC aims to develop an enterprise fabric to accommodate AI projects and interconnect DOD components by enabling data sharing across components using different platforms.
candidate.excerpt_zh: 据JAIC主任称，JAIC旨在开发一个企业架构，通过支持使用不同平台的各组成部分之间的数据共享，来容纳人工智能项目并连接国防部各组成部分。
candidate.normalized_claim: JAIC旨在开发一个企业架构，通过支持跨平台数据共享来容纳人工智能项目并连接国防部各组成部分。

candidate.excerpt_original: The first development cycle, or “spiral challenge,” started in December 2023, is focused on developing platforms with agnostic autonomy features. The performers are expected to demonstrate a full working solution to the first challenge in March 2024.
candidate.excerpt_zh: 第一个开发周期，即“螺旋挑战”，于2023年12月开始，专注于开发具有不可知自主功能的平台。预计执行者将在2024年3月展示第一个挑战的完整工作解决方案。
candidate.normalized_claim: REMA项目第一个开发周期于2023年12月开始，预计在2024年3月展示完整工作解决方案。

candidate.excerpt_original: Although numerous entities across DOD are acquiring, developing, or already using AI, DOD has not issued department-wide guidance for how its components should approach acquiring AI.
candidate.excerpt_zh: 尽管国防部众多实体正在采购、开发或已经使用人工智能，国防部尚未发布全部门范围的指导方针，说明其各组成部分应如何采购人工智能。
candidate.normalized_claim: 截至2023年6月，美国国防部尚未发布全部门范围的人工智能采办指导方针。

candidate.excerpt_original: Various DOD components and military services have individually developed or plan to develop their own informal AI acquisition resources.
candidate.excerpt_zh: 国防部各组成部分和军种已单独制定或计划制定各自的非正式人工智能采办资源。
candidate.normalized_claim: 截至2023年6月，美国国防部各组成部分和军种已单独制定或计划制定各自非正式的人工智能采办资源。

candidate.excerpt_original: Although numerous DOD components are acquiring, developing, or already using AI, DOD has not issued comprehensive department-wide guidance for AI acquisitions.
candidate.excerpt_zh: 尽管许多国防部组成机构正在采购、开发或已经使用人工智能，但国防部尚未发布全面的部门范围内的人工智能采办指南。
candidate.normalized_claim: 截至报告所述期间，国防部尚未发布全面的部门范围内的人工智能采办指南。

candidate.excerpt_original: Implementing RAI in the DoD will not succeed with a set of rigid, one-size-fits-all requirements. A flexible approach is required to foster innovative thinking, as needs and complexity will vary based on factors such as technical maturity and context in which AI will be used.
candidate.excerpt_zh: 在国防部实施负责任人工智能不会通过一套僵化、一刀切的要求取得成功。需要灵活的方法来促进创新思维，因为需求和复杂性将根据技术成熟度和人工智能使用背景等因素而变化。
candidate.normalized_claim: 国防部负责任人工智能实施需要灵活方法，需求和复杂性因技术成熟度和使用背景而异。

candidate.excerpt_original: For each RAT Foundational Tenet, lines of ef fort (LOEs) accompany each with overarching goals, corresponding Office(s) of Primary Responsibility (OPRs), and the estimated time horizon for implementation where known.
candidate.excerpt_zh: 对于每个负责任人工智能基础原则，配套的工作线包含总体目标、相应的主要责任办公室以及已知的预计实施时间范围。
candidate.normalized_claim: 国防部负责任人工智能战略为每个基础原则配套工作线，明确总体目标、主要责任办公室和预计实施时间范围。

candidate.excerpt_original: LOE 2.1.3: Create a test range environment and central repository of CDAO in coordination tools for T&E of Al, linking lo existing and emerging equivalent with the DoD Test environments, that enables easy and continuous Resource Management testing for DoD testers.
candidate.excerpt_zh: LOE 2.1.3：创建一个测试靶场环境和AI测试与评估工具中央存储库，与国防部现有和新兴的等效环境连接，使国防部测试人员能够轻松进行持续测试。
candidate.normalized_claim: 美国国防部计划创建一个AI测试与评估的测试靶场环境和中央工具存储库，并与现有和新兴的国防部环境连接。

candidate.excerpt_original: AIDP sets the foundation for future technology integration such as big data analytics, artificial intelligence & machine learning.
candidate.excerpt_zh: AIDP为未来技术集成（如大数据分析、人工智能和机器学习）奠定了基础。
candidate.normalized_claim: AIDP为未来集成大数据分析、人工智能和机器学习等技术奠定基础。

candidate.excerpt_original: AIDP’s automation capabilities help maintain a comprehensive operational picture and allows for better, more responsive handling of information during multi-domain operations because it is always gathering and processing data.
candidate.excerpt_zh: AIDP的自动化能力有助于维护全面的作战态势图，并能在多域作战中更好、更及时地处理信息，因为它始终在收集和处理数据。
candidate.normalized_claim: AIDP的自动化能力有助于维护全面的作战态势图，并在多域作战中更好地处理信息。

rejection_reasons: The claim states AIDP's automation capabilities 'help maintain' and 'allows for better handling', which implies an observed result. However, the excerpt describes these as capabilities without reporting an observed test or operational result. The evidence nature is declared as test_result, but the excerpt does not report an observed function, performance, or result from a test or exercise.

candidate.excerpt_original: “We planned this exercise to demonstrate how artificial intelligence and unmanned systems effectively increase CTF Sentinel’s maritime domain awareness to maintain maritime security in Middle Eastern waters,” said Royal Saudi Navy Capt. Alamri Assem, CTF Sentinel’s director of plans.
candidate.excerpt_zh: “我们计划这次演习是为了展示人工智能和无人系统如何有效提升CTF Sentinel的海上态势感知能力，以维护中东水域的海上安全，”沙特皇家海军上校、CTF Sentinel计划主任Alamri Assem说。
candidate.normalized_claim: CTF Sentinel计划主任表示，该演习旨在展示人工智能和无人系统如何有效提升其海上态势感知能力。

candidate.excerpt_original: The systems were able to help locate and identify objects in nearby waters and relay visual depictions to watchstanders.
candidate.excerpt_zh: 这些系统能够帮助定位和识别附近水域的物体，并将视觉图像传送给值班人员。
candidate.normalized_claim: 在演习中，无人和人工智能系统能够帮助定位和识别附近水域的物体，并将视觉图像传送给值班人员。

candidate.excerpt_original: “Saildrones transmitted information on contacts of interest and our watch officers coordinated with the destroyer for further monitoring,” said U.S. Navy Capt. Brian Granger, CTF Sentinel’s deputy commander.
candidate.excerpt_zh: “Saildrone传输了有关感兴趣目标的信息，我们的值班军官与驱逐舰协调进行进一步监控，”美国海军上校、CTF Sentinel副指挥官Brian Granger说。
candidate.normalized_claim: Saildrone传输了感兴趣目标的信息，值班军官与驱逐舰协调进行进一步监控。

candidate.excerpt_original: The late-summer event was the first time IMSC planners specifically designed a Sentinel Shield exercise to integrate unmanned systems.
candidate.excerpt_zh: 夏末的这次活动是IMSC规划人员首次专门设计Sentinel Shield演习以整合无人系统。
candidate.normalized_claim: 夏末的Sentinel Shield演习是IMSC规划人员首次专门设计以整合无人系统。
